import os
from pypdf import PdfReader

print("Workspace contents:")
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
    # Skip hidden dirs like .codex
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
    for f in files:
        full = os.path.join(root, f)
        print(f"  {full} ({os.path.getsize(full)} bytes)")

pdf_path = "report.pdf"
if os.path.exists(pdf_path):
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_path)
    print(f"\nreport.pdf info:")
    print(f"  Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")
    page = reader.pages[0]
    print(f"  Page size (pts): {page.mediabox.width} x {page.mediabox.height}")
    meta = reader.metadata
    if meta:
        print(f"  Metadata title: {meta.title}")
    # Check first page's text to see content type
    txt = page.extract_text()
    print(f"  First page text preview: {str(txt)[:200]!r}")
else:
    print("\nreport.pdf NOT FOUND in workspace")

import os

skill_dir = ".codex/skills/pdf"
print("Skill directory tree:")
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(skill_dir):
    depth = root.replace(skill_dir, "").count(os.sep)
    indent = "  " * depth
    print(f"{indent}{os.path.basename(root)}/")
    for f in files:
        full = os.path.join(root, f)
        print(f"{indent}  {f} ({os.path.getsize(full)} bytes)")

import re, sys

data = open("report.pdf", "rb").read()
print("File size:", len(data), "bytes")
print("Header:", data[:16])

# Find startxref
m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
if m:
    startxref = int(m.group(1))
    print("startxref offset:", startxref)
else:
    print("No startxref found")

# Look at the trailer area
print("\n--- Last 600 bytes ---")
print(data[-600:].decode("latin-1"))

# Check for xref stream markers
print("\n--- Checks ---")
print("xref table (classic):", b"\nxref" in data[-2000:])
print("Type /XRef present:", b"/XRef" in data[-2000:])
print("ObjStm present:", b"/ObjStm" in data[-2000:])
print("FlateDecode present:", b"/FlateDecode" in data[:50000])

# Look for page count in pages tree
for pat in [rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", rb"/MediaBox\s*\[([^\]]+)\]", rb"/Type\s*/Page"]:
    found = re.findall(pat, data[:200000])
    print(f"Pattern {pat}: first few matches -> {found[:5]}")

import re

data = open("report.pdf", "rb").read()

# Parse classic xref table
m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
startxref = int(m.group(1))
trailer_start = data.rfind(b"trailer", 0, startxref)
xref_start = data.rfind(b"xref", 0, trailer_start)
print("xref_start:", xref_start, "trailer_start:", trailer_start, "startxref:", startxref)

# xref section text
section = data[xref_start:trailer_start]
print("xref section:")
print(section.decode("latin-1"))

# Parse entries: lines like "0000000061 00000 n"
entries = re.findall(rb"(\d{10}) (\d{5}) ([nf])", section)
offsets = {}
for i, (off, gen, typ) in enumerate(entries):
    if typ == b"n":
        offsets[i] = int(off)
print("Object offsets:", offsets)

# Extract each object
for num, off in sorted(offsets.items()):
    end = data.find(b"endobj", off)
    obj_bytes = data[off:end + len(b"endobj")]
    print(f"\n===== Object {num} (offset {off}, {len(obj_bytes)} bytes) =====")
    print(obj_bytes[:400].decode("latin-1"))
